title: Swiss rail lines
description: lines.json as pnpm build:data writes it. lines.csv and line_stops.csv are the same records flattened: a line's operators and route_ids joined with ';', its stops one row each with the line's id in front.

lines.description: Ordered by id, compared by UTF-16 code unit.

didok.description: Didok number, which is also the UIC number: seven digits, the first two the country.

listItem.description: One value of a list, which the CSVs join with ';', so it cannot hold one.

id.description: Region, colon, line number or category and terminals. Stable across feeds.

network_region.description: The region slug, the part of the id before the colon.

operators.description: Every operator that runs the line, by the feed's name, ordered by code unit.

terminal_a.description: Name of the first stop of the trunk. Swiss.

terminal_b.description: Name of the last stop of the trunk. Swiss.

true_terminal_a.description: Where the trains beyond terminal_a really end, abroad for an international line; otherwise terminal_a.

true_terminal_b.description: Where the trains beyond terminal_b really end, abroad for an international line; otherwise terminal_b.

route_ids.description: The feed's route_ids merged into the line. Renumbered by every feed, so never an identity. Empty on a hand-seeded line.

seasonal.description: Runs in fewer than two thirds of the feed year's weeks. Null on a hand-seeded line.

trips_per_week.description: Departures in the reference week. Null on a hand-seeded line.

stops.description: The canonical sequence: the trunk in running order, then each branch block.

sequence.description: Position in the canonical sequence, from 1 without gaps.

sloid.description: Swiss Location ID, null where the feed gives none.

didok.description: Null only for a hand-seeded stop the service-point register does not know.

via.description: How the stop got its place in the sequence.

junction.description: The stop it was placed against: where a detour left, the end an extension continues, where a branch block starts. Null on the backbone.
